raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager (f/m/x) - remote
raw.excerpt: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
raw.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for three consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager (f/m/x) to lead our PlatformandData Engineering teams. These are supporting teams, their mission is to multiply the effectiveness of every product squad at refurbed by providing reliable infrastructure, shared services, clean data, and developer tooling. You will own the technical foundation that product teams build on, and ensure it is stable, scalable, and easy to work with.

Our platform technology stack includes Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ on the backend, with infrastructure running on Google Cloud Platform provisioned with Terraform, and orchestrated with Kubernetes. Our data platform is built with Python on top of BigQuery.

WHO YOU ARE:

Leadership

  • You are a senior, trusted engineering leader with 8+ years of experience managing engineers in platform, infrastructure, or data teams
  • You have led teams where the customer is internal, you understand what it means to provide a service to other engineers and how to measure success in that context
  • You have a proven ability to develop, mentor, and retain engineering talent, as well as manage performance with clarity and empathy
  • You lead with low ego, openness, and a belief in autonomy and empowerment, where engineers take ownership and collaborate effectively
  • You partner with product managers and engineering leaders to evolve Platform and Data Engineering as products
  • You establish feedback loops and metrics to understand developer experience, delivery friction, and engineering effectiveness, using those insights to guide investments

Technical experience

  • You have a strong background in cloud infrastructure, ideally GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, BigQuery), but AWS or Azure also relevant
  • You have experience designing and operating Kubernetes-based environments including CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and observability stacks
  • You understand data engineering fundamentals: pipeline design, data warehouse modeling, transformation tooling, and data quality practices
  • You are comfortable reviewing infrastructure-as-code, participating in architecture reviews, and guiding trade-off discussions around reliability, cost, and performance
  • You have a solid understanding of backend systems, distributed architectures, and how scalable services are designed, enabling you to actively participate in architectural discussions and guide teams toward sound decisions
  • You understand SQL, relational database concepts, and modern backend development practices well enough to provide context, make informed decisions, and remove ambiguity
  • While you are not expected to be hands-on day to day, you feel confident reviewing high-level designs, evaluating trade-offs, and ensuring that the team ships robust, thoughtful solutions

Collaboration

  • You thrive in environments where your team's success is measured by the success of others, you view other engineering teams as your primary stakeholders
  • You build trust across teams through reliability, transparency, and clear communication of your team's roadmap, incidents, and limitations
  • You influence through clarity and context rather than authority, building alignment across teams and domains
  • You are skilled at understanding the needs of product squads and translating them into infrastructure priorities, developer tooling improvements, or data platform investments

Engineering culture

  • You cultivate a culture focused on ownership and reliability
  • You promote modern engineering practices, clear and simple processes
  • You foster transparency, feedback, and knowledge-sharing
  • You reject blame culture and treat incidents as learning opportunities
  • You are self-directed, aligned with objectives, and comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • You are confident representing your teams across the whole organization and with company leadership

Additional background

  • Excellent English skills and based in Europe
  • Strong background in software engineering, infrastructure, or data systems, with a strong foundation for systems thinking
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider at depth (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure also relevant)
  • Background in either platform/infrastructure or data engineering at depth, with meaningful exposure to the other

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Manage and support engineers across the Platform and Data Engineering teams, ensuring clear mission, healthy processes, and a productive working environment that doesn't depend on individual heroics
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, mentor engineers, and support their personal and professional growth
  • Build psychological safety, enable ownership, and help team members unlock their potential
  • Facilitate technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design decisions to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability
  • Ensure your teams produce high-quality engineering outcomes by promoting best practices and establishing clear quality standards
  • Contribute to code reviews or smaller technical tasks when needed, while keeping your focus on team impact not hands-on development
  • Ensure infrastructure and data systems can support refurbed's growth ambitions
  • Identify and resolve blockers, surface risks early, and maintain a productive environment where teams can move quickly with clarity
  • Contribute to company, department and squad-level planning, driving both short- and long-term infrastructure and data strategies
  • Participate in hiring and team growth, building a strong bench of senior engineers across both domains
  • Strengthen the engineering culture through feedback, knowledge sharing, documentation, and leading by example
  • Encourage experimentation, learning, and adoption of modern tools and practices, including AI-assisted engineering tools where they deliver meaningful outcomes
  • Define and track success metrics for Platform and Data Engineering, including reliability, developer experience, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and engineering effectiveness (e.g. using DORA/SPACE Framework)

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

  • Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!
  • We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.
  • You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!
  • No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

  • You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.
  • We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.
  • We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

  • We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊
  • We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.
  • You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See https://careers.refurbed.com/ for further insights!

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Sr Product Marketing Manager at Coupa:

As a Sr Product Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in elevating our market presence and driving the success of our Spend Management solutions. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing, you’ll be the voice of the customer and the champion of our value—fueling growth through strategic storytelling, strong market insight, and powerful enablement.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape Value and Tell the Story
  • Develop compelling product positioning and messaging rooted in a deep understanding of procurement personas.
  • Highlight the unique business value of our solutions in a way that resonates with both business and technical audiences.
  • Serve as a passionate spokesperson in webinars, customer sessions, and events.
  • Fuel Sales Success
  • Create high-impact content and tools—from decks and battlecards to solution briefs and customer stories—that empower our field teams to win.
  • Partner with enablement to deliver targeted training programs that keep our go-to-market teams sharp and confident.
  • Drive Go-to-Market Execution
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Sales to build and launch campaigns and initiatives that accelerate pipeline growth, adoption, and customer retention.
  • Gather and translate market, customer, and competitive insights into actionable strategies that inform product direction and sales focus.
  • Champion the Voice of the Customer
  • Engage regularly with customers and prospects to gather real-world insights, support strategic deals, and surface advocates for case studies and speaking opportunities.
  • Use customer feedback and market trends to shape content, refine messaging, and influence roadmap decisions.
  • Influence Leadership Position Through Analyst Relations
  • Partner with the Analyst Relations and Product teams to shape compelling narratives and briefing content that reinforce our leadership in the sourcing and procurement space.
  • Help craft our point of view for analyst evaluations, ensuring our differentiation and value are clearly represented.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

  • 5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain technology.
  • A talent for turning complex concepts into clear, compelling messaging and market-facing content.
  • Experience leading go-to-market strategies and supporting product launches with measurable business impact.
  • Strong collaboration skills—you know how to work across teams and influence stakeholders at all levels, even without direct authority.
  • A data-driven mindset—you bring structure to ambiguity, uncover insights from data, and use them to inform decisions and storytelling.
  • Experience presenting to both internal and external audiences, including sales teams and executive stakeholders.
  • A self-starter mentality with a passion for solving problems, moving fast, and delivering results.
  • Resilience, adaptability, and an unshakable drive to keep pushing forward—even when the path isn’t clearly defined.
  • A high-energy, proactive attitude—you bring passion, momentum, and urgency to everything you do.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

dein arbeitsumfeld

Brennst Du für spannende Projekte und strebst praktische Erfahrung in einem dynamischen Team an? Unterstütze uns ab sofort für mindestens drei (bevorzugt sechs) Monate als Praktikant (m/w/d) oder Werkstudent (w/m/d) im Geschäftsbereich Automotive.

raw.description:
ICF is seeking an experienced Lead Application Architect to define and guide the end-to-end architecture for mission-critical systems supporting Federal land management agencies, including USFS, USDA, DOI, and BLM. This role provides technical leadership across engineering teams, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with modern cloud-based architectures and Federal security requirements. The ideal candidate brings deep experience designing enterprise systems, establishing technical standards, and guiding development teams to deliver interoperable, high-performing platforms that support complex operational and mission workflows.

Job Location: This position requires that the job be performed in the United States.  If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and also prohibits personal VPN connections.

  • You may be asked to travel once a quarter to an office.

  • Our core work hours are 10am - 4pm Eastern Time with the option to start earlier or work later depending on your time zone.

What You Will Do:

  • Define and maintain the overall solution architecture, technical standards, and reference architectures supporting mission-critical systems.

  • Lead architectural design decisions across multiple development teams to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable system solutions.

  • Establish integration patterns, API strategies, and interoperability approaches that support enterprise data exchange and mission workflows.

  • Ensure system designs meet nonfunctional requirements including performance, availability, scalability, and reliability.

  • Guide engineering teams in implementing cloud-native architectures (primarily Azure, with AWS familiarity a plus) using modern development and microservices-based approaches.

  • Align architecture and system designs with Federal security and compliance requirements, including ATO processes and associated controls.

  • Conduct architecture reviews, technical governance activities, and design evaluations to ensure alignment with enterprise standards.

  • Identify modernization opportunities and lead initiatives to reduce technical debt while improving system maintainability and performance.

  • Mentor engineers and technical leads, promoting architecture best practices and continuous technical improvement across teams.

What You Will Bring With You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or solution architecture roles.

  • At least 5 years of experience serving as a lead architect or senior technical architect guiding enterprise system architecture decisions.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.

What We Would Like You To Bring With You:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.

  • Architecture or cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, or TOGAF.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-level architectures supporting complex systems and integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions within cloud environments (Azure preferred; AWS familiarity a plus).

  • Experience aligning system architecture with Federal security requirements and supporting compliance frameworks such as ATO processes.

  • Experience supporting Federal agencies, particularly land management or environmental mission organizations.

  • Experience designing microservices-based architectures and enterprise integration frameworks.

  • Familiarity with geospatial systems, environmental data platforms, or mission-support applications used in land management or wildfire operations.

  • Experience leading modernization initiatives involving legacy system transformation to cloud-native architectures.

Professional Skills:

  • Strong technical leadership and architectural decision-making capabilities across complex system environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-team technical collaboration and guide engineering teams through complex design decisions.

  • Ability to balance mission needs, technical constraints, and long-term architectural sustainability in fast-paced Agile delivery environments.

At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. From our employees to our dealers, partners, and borrowers, we’ve built a company and a culture around a resolute belief in the promise and power of diversity. We value independent and critical thinking.

As an Insurance Claims Associate, you will play a pivotal role in working towards maximizing the financial recoveries for Lendbuzz. You will ensure that our clients receive the support and assistance they need to navigate auto insurance claims effectively. You will also ensure that Insurance companies pay us and our customers promptly and accurately. This role will require cross functional collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders. Your attention to detail, strong communication skills, and commitment to customer satisfaction will contribute to our continued success.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist clients in the initiation of auto insurance claims, providing guidance and support through the initial reporting process

  • Follow up with insurance companies to check on status of claims and troubleshoot any hold ups / blockers in their processing

  • Gather and review all necessary documentation related to insurance claims, including accident reports, policy details, and other relevant information

  • Verify the accuracy and completeness of claims, ensuring they meet company and industry standards

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, insurance providers, and third parties involved in the claims process. Maintain clear and timely communication to keep all stakeholders informed

  • Work with insurance providers to process claims efficiently and accurately, following up on any outstanding issues or discrepancies

  • Provide exceptional customer support to clients, addressing their questions and concerns while ensuring a seamless claims experience

  • Maintain detailed and organized records of claims, correspondence, and associated documentation

  • Assist in the resolution of claims issues, including coverage disputes, repair estimates, and settlements

  • Identify opportunities to enhance our claims process and provide feedback for process improvement

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field preferred

  • 1+ years of experience in the insurance industry preferred

  • Previous experience in auto insurance claims or a related field is preferred

  • Proficiency in English is required, ability to also speak Spanish and/or Portuguese is preferred

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational abilities

  • Customer service focussed with a commitment to delivering a positive experience

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Adept at problem-solving and conflict resolution

  • Adherence to ethical and professional standards in the insurance industry

We believe:
Diversityis a competitive advantage. We celebrate our differences, and are better when we have a variety of experiences, viewpoints, and backgrounds.
Compassionis a strength. We care about our customers and look to build long-term relationships with them.
Simplicityis a key feature. We work hard to make our forms and processes as painless and intuitive as possible.
Honesty and transparency are non negotiable. We incorporate these traits in all of our interactions.
Financial opportunity belongs to everyone. We work every day to improve lives by extending this opportunity.
If you believe these things too then we would love to hear from you!

Background Checks

After an offer is accepted, Lendbuzz conducts a pre-employment background check. Any evaluation of the background check will be subject to an individualized assessment, taking into account the applicant’s or employee’s specific record and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.

A Note on Recruiting Outreach

We’ve been made aware of individuals falsely claiming to represent Lendbuzz using lookalike email addresses (eg @lendbuzzcareers.com). Please note that all legitimate emails from our team come from @lendbuzz.com. We will never ask for sensitive information or conduct interviews via messaging apps.

raw.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the company

A fast-growing performance marketing and business consultancy, our client specializes in scaling service-based businesses through a proprietary AI-driven expansion engine. By focusing on the insulation and home services sectors, the team moves beyond traditional lead generation to provide a comprehensive growth suite that includes paid acquisition, sales process optimization, and operational infrastructure. They partner with high-intent firms to bridge the gap between marketing spend and closed revenue, utilizing advanced automation and data-driven creative strategies to help partners achieve seven-figure growth.

The company operates with a high-performance, results-oriented culture that prioritizes efficiency and transparent communication. As a scaling firm, they offer a collaborative environment where team members focus on solving complex bottlenecks in the sales funnel and hiring landscape. Their mission is to transform local service providers into market leaders by implementing scalable systems that maximize long-term profitability and brand dominance. This is an ideal environment for those passionate about marketing innovation, conversion integrity, and measurable business impact.

Job Summary

We are looking for a high-performance Senior Media Buyer to spearhead Meta ad strategy for a rapidly growing marketing and consulting firm. This is not a "maintenance" role; we are looking for a strategic powerhouse who can take full ownership of a portfolio of insulation and home improvement businesses. You will be responsible for driving high-ticket lead generation, optimizing complex funnels, and managing client relationships directly. This position is designed for an expert who thrives on extreme ownership and is ready to transition into a leadership role as we continue to scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize Meta ad campaigns for a portfolio of 10+ active client accounts.
  • Launch, test, and iterate on lead gen funnels, VSLs, and booked-call workflows.
  • Take full ownership of client relationships, leading weekly performance calls and reporting.
  • Analyze performance data to make proactive, real-time adjustments to budgets and scaling strategies.
  • Partner with the founder to develop high-converting ad creatives, hooks, and messaging.
  • Systematize and document internal processes to ensure quality stays high as the department grows.
  • Monitor lead quality and funnel economics to ensure clients achieve a minimum 2x ROAS.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes to insulate clients from market volatility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and scale high-performing Meta (90%) and Google Ads (10%) campaigns, focusing on Search, Display, and Performance Max.
  • Continuously monitor and refine campaigns to meet strict KPI targets, including Cost Per Lead (CPL) and Cost Per Sale.
  • Design and optimize high-converting landing pages (via Perspective) to ensure maximum lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Build and manage lead nurturing workflows and integrations within GoHighLevel to ensure seamless lead delivery to clients.
  • Work alongside the Creative Lead and Account Management team to translate performance data into actionable growth strategies.
  • Prepare and communicate campaign results internally and support the account manager in client-facing updates.

Requirements

  • Proven experience managing $30k–$100k+ in monthly Meta ad spend across multiple accounts.
  • Deep expertise in high-ticket lead generation for home services, home improvement, or contractor verticals.
  • Demonstrated track record of scaling campaigns profitably and optimizing for sales-ready inspections/applications.
  • Previous experience mentoring junior media buyers or reviewing account work.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to lead client calls independently and handle difficult conversations with confidence.
  • A structured, scientific methodology for testing audiences and creatives—no ad-hoc experimentation.
  • Data-driven mindset with a primary focus on ROI, CPA, and funnel efficiency.
  • Extreme ownership mentality: you identify and solve problems before leadership notices them.
  • Experience building and optimizing VSL-based funnels.
  • Advanced knowledge of CRM integration and lead tracking for home service businesses.
  • Background in copywriting or creative direction specifically for Meta direct-response ads.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world. ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations. For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.

The kind of people we look for:

  • Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
  • Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
  • Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
  • Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

Summary:

The PMO Supervisor will support the delivery engine of the PMO. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across all projects by overseeing project management standards, auditing delivery practices, and coaching project teams. Under the direction of the Manager, PMO, the PMO Supervisor maintains operational discipline across Project Managers, Scrum Masters, and Project Coordinators. This role serves as the day-to-day quality control function of the PMO, ensuring all work is executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and expectations.

What This Role Does:

  • Reviews and validates project plans to ensure alignment with PMO standards, templates, and delivery methodology.
  • Ensures all projects maintain accurate schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource alignment.
  • Provides feedback to project managers on gaps, inconsistencies, risks and stakeholders alignment based on project plans built by PMs and enforce corrective actions.
  • Monitors execution across project managers to ensure consistency and adoption of stage gates process.
  • Establishes and enforces PMO operating rhythms (weekly status, bi-weekly project health checks).
  • Defines regular project audits and health checks across active projects.
  • Ensures adherence to PMO standards, SDLC, Agile practices, and governance frameworks, including artifacts completion for each stage gate and maintains traceability across decisions, approvals and deliverables.
  • Tracks project plans audit findings, creates an action plan and shares remediation actions with PMO leadership.
  • Escalates systemic execution issues and risks to PMO leadership on project managers having challenges with driving timelines, decision points and following escalation paths.
  • Provides hands-on coaching to Project Managers, Scrum Masters, and Project Coordinators.
  • Partners with Supervisor of business and technical analyst to recommend PMO process improvements towards achieving optimal resource balance, scalability and operational efficiency.
  • Reinforces PMO best practices in planning, risk management, and communication, while driving consistency and standardization across delivery teams.
  • Acts as a point of escalation for delivery challenges and supports resolution of risks, issues, and blockers.
  • Ensures timely and accurate project status reporting and provides visibility into project health and execution trends.
  • Identifies trends across projects and recommends process and execution improvements to enhance delivery effectiveness.
  • Takes an active approach to talent management by onboarding, mentoring, and inspiring a diverse, highly engaged, and skilled team. Continuously strengthens team capability through talent development, succession planning, and recruitment.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required, a bachelor’s degree is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of proven experience as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager is required; 10 years is preferred.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of experience leading PMO operations, with a minimum of three (3) years in people management. This includes accountability for performance, development, and delivery of results aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Experience adopting PMO or governance-driven environment.
  • Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, and dependency management.
  • Strong understanding of risk, issue, and change management.
  • Support managing resource capacity plans.
  • Experience assessing and improving project plans, managing multiple concurrent projects, and conducting project audits or health checks.
  • Ability to coach and develop delivery teams, hold peers accountable, and drive corrective action.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify trends across multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, MS Project, Confluence.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, including mentoring others, leading initiatives or workstreams, contributing to best practices, and driving cross-functional outcomes.
  • Respectful and outstanding leadership skills that motivate colleagues to focus their energy on achieving business goals.
  • Ability to plan and manage at both strategic and tactical operational levels. Works to achieve goals while overcoming obstacles and/or planning for contingencies.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across all levels of the organization including executive communication.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and modern collaboration platforms (e.g., MS Teams, Slack).
  • Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively to foster a high-quality, results-driven, team-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed and travel up to 10%, which may include occasional overnight travel.

• Preferred:

◦ PMP certification ◦ Scrum certification

Physical Demands:

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with documented disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodations would impose an undue hardship. Employees seeking accommodation should contact the People Department to initiate the interactive process. Employees may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time:

  • Sitting, standing, and walking (95-100%)
  • Keyboarding (40-60%)
  • Viewing computer monitor, tablet, and cell phone requiring close vision (95-100%)

Work Environment:

100% Remote with Travel: Work environment is primarily indoors (home office, customer or vendor sites, or other business meeting venues); travel may involve exposure to varying weather and temperature conditions, as well as driving and traffic hazards. Travel is required, approximately 10%, and may include overnight and out-of-state trips. (sales roles and roles with travel)

Compensation:

$115,000 to $125,000 plus 5% determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity considerations. Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. For details on our comprehensive benefits program, visit www.clearcaptions.com/careers to explore our total rewards package.

Intrigued to learn more? When you apply for this role, your information will be personally reviewed by our talent acquisition team (not by a robot). You can expect to hear back from us if we think there could be a fit and what next steps look like. ClearCaptions is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusion and diversity. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Disclaimer:

The above information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to do this job. ClearCaptions does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the US without a current or future need for Visa sponsorship.

Protecting Your Candidate Experience At ClearCaptions, your candidate experience matters to us. To ensure transparency and security throughout the hiring process, please keep the following in mind:

  • All legitimate ClearCaptions job openings are posted exclusively on this careers page.
  • Our recruiters will only contact you from verified @clearcaptions.com email addresses.
  • We will never offer a job through LinkedIn messages or any social media platform.
  • We will never ask for sensitive personal information (like banking details or Social Security numbers) during early stages of the hiring process.

We encourage all applicants to stay vigilant against online job scams, especially those that misuse company names or logos to appear legitimate. If you receive a message that seems suspicious or doesn’t follow these guidelines, please don’t engage. You’re welcome to verify any opportunity by reaching out to us directly at recruiting@clearcaptions.com. We’re committed to a hiring process that is respectful, secure, and clear every step of the way.

raw.title: Operations Associate - AI Developer
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityJoin Sitetracker's Operations team and play a pivotal role in shaping our AI-first future, directly enabling our customer-facing teams across the business.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

Join Sitetracker's Operations team and play a pivotal role in shaping our AI-first future, directly enabling our customer-facing teams across the business. This is a unique opportunity to build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations from the ground up, replacing manual processes and dramatically increasing the velocity and efficiency of critical business functions. You'll be at the forefront of structuring our team around cutting-edge AI, not just layering it on top, seeing the direct business impact of every solution you create.

What You'll Do

As an Operations Associate - AI Developer, you will step into a brand-new role designed to leverage your expertise with leading AI tools like Claude, Agentforce, Cursor, and Gemini, alongside agent frameworks, to construct intelligent automations that live inside and interact with Salesforce. This includes building Salesforce Flows, Apex backed automations, LWC components, and AI powered actions that read and write to Salesforce objects, surfacing insights, triggering workflows, and eliminating manual work across our Customer Experience organization.

This role operates on an afternoon shift to ensure meaningful overlap with the US-based Director of Operations and the broader Customer Experience team. For candidates based in Mexico City, this means approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST. The majority of design document handoffs, build reviews, and quality gate discussions happen during the overlap window with EST time.

You will receive clear, structured design requirements and user stories from the Director of Operations and independently translate these briefs into fully functional AI agents, automations, and skills. This role is part of a dynamic, shared builder pool, requiring you to demonstrate cross-domain capability, seamlessly executing builds across both process automation and Salesforce systems domains to deliver high-impact solutions for our global operations.

You will execute a complete build cycle for every assignment: read and clarify the design document and user stories before starting, build independently, self-test against defined acceptance criteria, and submit a fully documented build — including test data and expected outputs — for quality review. Builds that pass the quality gate go to production. Builds that do not come back with a clear failure report, and you address them before

The Skills You'll Have

AI Tool Fluency & Agent Building

  • Build multiple AI-assisted automations or agents in a professional context.

  • Describe your design-to-build process, including how you test outputs and articulate end-user interaction.

  • Write or review effective prompt engineering logic, explaining how specific structures optimize outputs.

  • Define and execute AI agent quality testing, including regression checks and documenting expected vs. actual outputs.

  • Deploy AI agents or automations in a production environment, defining scope, writing prompts, validating outputs, and documenting for handoff.

Salesforce Administration, Configuration & Development

  • Configure complex Salesforce Flows, validation rules, or automation in a professional context.

  • Understand Salesforce object relationships, APIs, and data management.

  • Read and interpret basic Apex or SOQL to understand existing code or automation.

  • Build Salesforce automations that connect to external systems or trigger cross-object workflows.

  • Troubleshoot complex configuration/code issues, manage permissions, and build multi-step conditional automations (declarative or programmatic).

Build Execution & Independent Build Delivery

  • Translate structured written designs and user stories into working builds with minimal iteration.

  • Self-test builds against acceptance criteria before submission.

  • Submit complete, well-documented builds with test data and expected outputs for QA review.

  • Define your own testing protocol for builds, including inputs, expected outcomes, and pass/fail criteria.

  • Deliver technical builds or configurations from written designs with a high first-pass acceptance rate, consistently describing your testing and documentation process.

Curiosity, Learning Agility & AI Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate active engagement with AI tools through built projects, published work, or professional application.

  • Proactively learn new AI tools or frameworks outside of formal training programs.

  • Introduce new AI tools or approaches to a team or project, describing the resulting impact.

  • Maintain a documented project history showcasing progressive AI and automation skill development.

  • Actively track developments in the AI and automation space, building personal projects or contributing to open-source AI automation, and articulating trade-offs between different AI tools.

Within 90 Days, You'll

  • Successfully build, test, and deploy at least 3 production AI agents or automations that actively reduce manual effort for Operations or a customer-facing function, with measurable output.

  • Demonstrate cross-domain capability by executing builds across both process automation and Salesforce systems domains, requiring minimal design requirement clarification.

  • Complete all initial builds through the quality gate process, submitting well-documented work with test data and addressing all failure reports.

Within 180 Days, You'll

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve existing agents, contributing ideas for enhanced performance and user experience.

  • Take full ownership of your build pipeline, managing priorities and delivering completed agents with minimal daily oversight, regardless of remote or timezone differences.

  • Deepen your understanding of the operational processes you are automating, actively contributing to user story and test case achievement for newly operationalized processes.

Within 365 Days, You'll

  • Become a key contributor to our growing AI automation strategy, influencing best practices and introducing innovative approaches to agent development.

  • Drive significant, measurable increases in velocity and efficiency for supported business functions through a robust portfolio of deployed AI agents and automations.

  • Chart a clear growth path towards a QA Analyst or senior builder role, demonstrating expertise in AI agent quality testing, design, and full-lifecycle deployment.

raw.title: Enterprise Account Executive - US
raw.excerpt: Sprinto is an AI-native GRC platform that helps organisations manage risks, audits, vendor oversight, and continuous monitoring from a single connected platform.
raw.description:
Sprinto is an AI-native GRC platform that helps organisations manage risks, audits, vendor oversight, and continuous monitoring from a single connected platform. With a team of 350+ employees serving 3,000+ customers across 75+ countries, Sprinto combines scale with expertise to deliver trust and compliance. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by leading organisations including Whatfix, Anaconda, Ultrahuman, WeWork, AI Foundation, and HackerRank, Sprinto supports 300+ integrations and 200+ global security standards, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
Founded in 2020 by second-time entrepreneurs Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto is recognised as a Leader on G2 in Compliance Automation and has been named a LinkedIn Top Startup multiple years in a row.

Sprint With Sprinters

At Sprinto, your work has purpose — and your life has space. We are a workplace where you’re empowered to execute on your most ambitious ideas and deliver your best output in a fast-paced, innovative, and supportive environment.
Joining Sprinto means you will never run alone; you will always have the freedom to take your shot and the support to go farther than you imagined.

What The Role Involves?

You will own the Enterprise segment in the US as an individual contributor. This means building your territory from zero, identifying and prioritizing the right accounts, and running full-cycle deals from first outreach to close without a playbook handed to you. Your buyers are CISOs, VP Engineering, and Heads of Compliance at companies with 2,500 to 5,000 employees. Deals average $100K in ACV and you will be working a focused account list.

You will have founder-level access and visibility, which means fast decisions, no bureaucracy, and a direct line to the people building the product.

What Your Impact Will Look Like:

  • Own a greenfield enterprise territory in the US from day one, building your pipeline from scratch with no inherited book of business.
  • Close net new enterprise logos in the $80K to $250K ACV range, targeting companies with 2,500 to 5,000 employees across your defined territory.
  • Run full-cycle, multi-threaded deals with buying committees that include CISOs, VP Engineering, and Heads of Compliance — not a single-contact motion.
  • Build and work a focused account list of under 100 accounts, prioritizing the top 40 to 50 with a replicable system rather than volume-based outreach.
  • Contribute directly to shaping what enterprise sales looks like at Sprinto in the US — your wins, losses, and learnings will inform the playbook.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Consultants and SDRs to bring the right support into deals at the right moment while owning the relationship and the close.
  • Forecast with discipline and accuracy, managing a pipeline that reflects reality rather than optimism.

What You’ll Bring To The Team:

  • A background at a challenger brand in cybersecurity, GRC, compliance, or security-adjacent SaaS — somewhere the brand did not open doors for you and you built pipeline through outbound discipline and genuine buyer relationships.
  • A track record of carrying and exceeding a quota of $1M or more as an individual contributor, sustained across at least two consecutive years.
  • Experience selling technical products to CISO, VP Engineering, or CTO buyers, with the ability to hold a credible conversation about security workflows and compliance requirements without a pre-sales engineer doing the heavy lifting.
  • A focused account prioritization system — you can explain exactly how you decide which accounts to go after, in what order, and why.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a genuine appetite for the blank canvas — you have built from zero before and that is the environment where you do your best work.
  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or Force Management applied consistently.

How Do We Care For Our Sprinters :

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so whether that is your home, a coffee shop, or somewhere with a better view, you get to choose.
  • Your health, covered: We take care of the what-ifs. Health, dental, and vision insurance so you and your family are protected and you can focus on doing your best work.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow, and commit to an annual reimbursement to help you level up your skills and stay sharp in your craft.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: Work from anywhere, and if that is home, we will chip in to help you build a setup that works as hard as you do.
  • The gear you need, sorted: We cover device reimbursement so you are never held back by the tools you are working with.

Inclusion & Diversity -

Sprinto is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status. You are welcome at Sprinto for who you are, and we encourage you to bring your complete selves to work. Our culture is built on the strength of diverse thinking — when people with different perspectives, ideas, and ways of solving problems come together, it fuels collaboration and accelerates our mission.
At Sprinto, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. Please share your request for reasonable accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process; we want to ensure everyone feels heard and seen.

raw.title: Director of Planning
raw.excerpt: Position Overview:The Director of Planning will lead the strategic direction, execution, and continuous improvement of integrated planning processes – spanning demand planning, supply (inventory) planning, and the full Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle – to support scalable growth and efficient operations.
raw.description:
Position Overview:

The Director of Planning will lead the strategic direction, execution, and continuous improvement of integrated planning processes – spanning demand planning, supply (inventory) planning, and the full Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle – to support scalable growth and efficient operations. This role is critical to driving supply chain excellence, enabling cross-functional alignment, and providing clear visibility into inventory health and business performance. As a player/coach, this role balances strategic leadership with hands-on execution. The ideal candidate is a proactive, collaborative leader with deep expertise across the end-to-end planning function, a strong analytical mindset, and a demonstrated ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

S&OP Leadership

  • Own, and continuously improve the end-to-end Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle, ensuring alignment across Demand, Supply, Finance, Commercial teams, Marketing, Logistics and Procurement.
  • Facilitate the monthly S&OP process including pre-S&OP meetings, executive S&OP review, and all supporting workstreams (demand review, supply review, financial reconciliation).
  • Run and execute Demand Planning (DP), Production/Master Planning (MPS), Distribution Planning (DRP) and Material Planning (MRP)
  • Drive the creation of integrated business plans that balance customer service, inventory investment, and financial targets.
  • Develop and maintain S&OP metrics and KPIs to monitor the effectiveness of the planning process
  • Ensure compliance with and reinforcement of the rules outlined in the S&OP and S&OE Playbook
  • Lead scenario planning and what-if analysis to prepare the business for potential disruptions, demand swings, or capacity constraints.
  • Champion S&OP maturity improvements, evolving the process from operational coordination to an integrated business management tool.
  • Ensure that the S&OP process maintains its routine and cadence, securing the active participation of all cross-functional areas to drive alignment, a single plan, and added value for the organization.
  • Advance the S&OP framework by leveraging best practices, emerging trends, external data streams, and technology to establish a continuous improvement mindset

Supply & Inventory Planning

  • Lead the development and execution of inventory and supply strategies to meet service level targets and financial (working capital) objectives.
  • Lead supply allocations and inventory OOS risk management for the company.
  • Oversee the supply planning process and inputs into S&OP, including optimizing Amazon FG inventory.
  • Partner with Finance and Sales to lead SKU rationalization across the company.
  • Direct the coffee planning process with key strategic co-manufacturing partner, driving alignment and execution.
  • Lead weekly co-man attainment metrics process and report out results; align data with co-man team.
  • Lead the At Risk resolution process, partnering with channel leaders to find creative solutions to reduce write-offs.
  • Oversee long-range working capital, supply, and capacity planning initiatives.
  • Lead initiatives such as inventory branding transitions and other cross-functional planning projects.
  • Lead the search for and implementation of a supply planning system.

Demand Planning

  • Own and lead the demand planning process, developing statistical and consensus-based forecasts across all channels (eCommerce, retail, DTC) and SKUs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to integrate market intelligence, promotional plans, new product launches, and customer insights into the demand plan.
  • Drive forecast accuracy improvement initiatives, establishing KPIs (MAPE, bias) and root cause analysis processes to continuously improve planning quality.
  • Lead new product introduction demand planning, partnering with Marketing and Sales to develop launch forecasts and lifecycle management plans.

Operational Execution & Oversight

  • Monitor critical KPIs, trend reports, and inventory health to inform decision-making and mitigate risks.
  • Oversee the team’s development and communication of production plans for existing items, new product introductions, and promotional activity.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Fulfillment, Procurement, Sourcing, Sales, and Marketing) to drive process improvement.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing planning team encompassing demand planning, supply planning, and S&OP functions.
  • Manage and mentor planning staff, offering strategic guidance, career development, and performance feedback.
  • Foster a high-performing, collaborative culture that drives results and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and influence other departments to guarantee engagement, synchronization, and accountability within the S&OP process

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or related field. Supplemented by a MBA or S&OP courses/trainings.
  • 10+ years of experience in S&OP and/or planning and 8+ years in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of FMCG experience.
  • Proven expertise in demand planning methodologies, statistical forecasting, and consensus-based planning processes.
  • Experience with demand and supply planning software.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, leading, or significantly improving an S&OP process.
  • Strong track record in supply chain planning, systems implementation, and cross-functional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with a business-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable influencing across all levels and leading through ambiguity and complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability working with co-manufacturers, preferably in the food & beverage industry.
  • Interpersonal effectiveness, strong organizational & communication skills, and the ability to achieve results in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Willingness to challenge the status quo and innovate.

Skills

  • Hard Skills
    • Demand planning, Inventory management, KPI management, Forecasting, Strategic planning, Data analysis.
  • Soft Skills
    • Resourcefulness and doer mindset; high emotional intelligence and assertiveness; stress management; leadership, personality and team building; organized and productive use of time; critical thinking, methodical and analytical; honesty and strong ethical principles; customer service centric; strategic vision; English proficiency.

Annual base salary gross: $150,000 – 175,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary range for this position. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other benefits include performance bonus program, generous time-off, flexible schedules, comprehensive health insurance (several options to choose from), 401k program with company match, paid parental leave, company paid disability insurance, and bulletproof.com store discount & credit.

This is a full-time position that is open to candidates located in the United States. Maximum fun, maximum knowledge, and maximum performance are a part of the job description, and you’ll get to work with the team on a regular basis to upgrade your game, your mental performance, and your life. This is a great opportunity to grow with a company.

At Bulletproof 360, Inc. (“Bulletproof”), we welcome employees and candidates with different backgrounds and perspectives. We value and trust each other – including our differences – while remaining true to our mission of improving lives. We encourage a corporate culture of self-expression, asking employees to be authentic to themselves. Our team brings together their unique perspectives, experiences, and passions in the work they do because we believe diversity makes us stronger, together.

Bulletproof aims to create a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our employees at all levels of the workforce without regard to age, race, color, sex, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity and/or expression, disability or any other laws. We strive to take steps in our recruiting practices by promoting diversity and fostering inclusion throughout our interview and hiring process, working toward the goal of a diverse and inclusive workforce

Grupo Mariposa's mission is to nurture growth and foster sustainability within the global food and beverage industry. We are committed to excellence through disciplined management, innovative practices and dynamic culture that embraces change.

Grupo Mariposa is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

At Bulletproof, we craft products to awaken the potential in every coffee afficionado. And we strive to help them transform and build confidence to own tomorrow. We pioneered a category that fused wellness and performance, and we believe now is the time to reclaim our place as one of the most recognizable, talked-about, and culture-shaping brands in health and nutrition.

We are a passionate, entrepreneurial team building products that deliver measurable performance — from pure, clean coffee to functional mix-ins. We’re distributed across eCommerce, Amazon, and retail partners nationwide, with a mission rooted in sustainability, high standards of product quality, and consumer trust.

Bulletproof is backed by Grupo Mariposa, one of the fastest growing food and beverage conglomerates in Latin-America and part of Bia Foods, a nourishing alliance – talent, companies, partners and brands connected to grow. Together, we’re expanding our reach while staying true to what matters: quality you can trust, benefits you can feel, and a daily routine that supports balance in body and mind.

raw.description:
About DEUNA 🧡
DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNA—the fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin America—ATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.
With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexico’s digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.
We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! 🚀
Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!
📌 Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the design, automation, and maintenance of our cloud infrastructure. This role will collaborate closely with development and operations teams to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and continuous improvement across our systems.
The ideal candidate has strong expertise in AWS, Infrastructure as Code, cloud networking, CI/CD, and container orchestration, and is comfortable mentoring other engineers.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Drive automation strategies for deployment and infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Own the architecture and management of AWS networking environments.
  • Lead the design and operation of containerized platforms and orchestration.
  • Architect, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines at scale.
  • Define and implement monitoring, observability, and alerting strategies.
  • Ensure end-to-end security, performance, scalability, and cost optimization of the infrastructure.
  • Act as a technical partner for engineering and operations teams to enable continuous delivery.
  • Evaluate, propose, and lead the adoption of new tools, technologies, and best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to engineers.
✅ Required Experience & Technical Skills
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in AWS cloud environments (non-negotiable).
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Proven experience with AWS networking, including VPC, VPN, Transit Gateway, and Flow Logs.
  • Experience designing and managing multi-region AWS architectures.
  • Solid background in CI/CD pipelines, automation, and deployment orchestration.
  • Strong experience with container platforms and orchestration: Docker, ECS, EKS (Kubernetes).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring, observability, and alerting tools.
  • Experience in scripting and automation, and infrastructure validation/testing.
  • Experience in performance optimization and cloud cost management.
  • Programming skills in at least one language: Python, JavaScript, or Go.
  • Native Spanish and Advanced English.
What will you find when you join DEUNA?
  • A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM
  • Dynamism, agility and constant innovation
  • Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region
  • The best tools and technology to operate
  • Being part of the startup culture.

raw.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

Job Description

Tailscale is seeking an experienced, highly technical, and commercially driven Solutions Engineer to partner with Sales in establishing and accelerating our business expansion across the APAC region. Based in Singapore, this individual will serve as our founding Solutions Engineer in the region and will report directly into the VP of Customer Engineering.

In this role, you will co-own a regional book of business with AE’s, driving complex multi-stakeholder deals, uncovering core organizational pain points, and engineering robust solution architectures. Beyond direct sales engagement, you will be a critical anchor for building out technical engagement across the region and collaborating closely with other newly emerging customer-facing technical teams in Singapore, such as Customer Support. This position sits at the center of technical depth and sharp commercial acumen with a mission to translate platform features into long-term customer trust and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the pioneering technical voice for Tailscale in APAC, cultivating market presence, initiating customer engagement frameworks, and defining regional technical execution strategies.
  • Partner closely with AEs to identify, qualify, design, and close new commercial opportunities, managing the regional pipeline effectively to hit and exceed quota outcomes.
  • Lead discovery workshops, deliver tailor-made product demonstrations, and manage technical POCs that resolve technical objections and shorten sales cycles.
  • Engage in direct R&D activities such as writing code, developing custom tool integrations, and contributing fixes or features directly back to Tailscale's core product to solve deep technical barriers for strategic regional customers.
  • Document and synthesize critical field insights, architectural trends, and regional product requirements to provide structured feedback that informs product, engineering, and GTM strategies.
  • Build reusable demo environments, solution blueprints, technical whitepapers, and objection-handling documentation to uplevel the global Solutions Engineering organization.
  • Collaborate with adjacent customer-facing technical teams simultaneously building out in Singapore to ensure tight feedback loops, consistent service delivery; partnering together to actively establish and anchor Tailscale’s company culture in the region.

What We Are Looking For

  • 4-5+ years of experience in a customer-facing Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solutions Architect capacity supporting high-growth networking, security, or enterprise cloud software platforms.
  • Proven success navigating ambiguity as a founding regional hire or operating within an early-stage, high-growth startup culture where process construction and individual ownership are required.
  • Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls) and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comprehensive understanding of zero-trust networking, secure connectivity, and IAM integrations (SSO, SAML, OIDC).
  • Hands-on experience designing, provisioning, or troubleshooting infrastructure within major cloud environments (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) and container environments (Docker, k8s).
  • Technical storytelling capacity, with an ability to link technical architectural decisions directly to strategic customer/business outcomes, and executive value propositions.
  • Outgoing communicator with strong interpersonal skills, capable of syncing seamlessly across fully distributed global engineering teams and regional sales groups.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $1000 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Generous parental leave program from your first day. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups for up to 26 weeks.

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

raw.description:
Adventus is an Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Solutions and Services Provider with a wide footprint across the globe.
We help organizations bring about positive transformation to their businesses by leveraging intelligent applications of innovative solutions and pertinent services to remain winners in today's ultra competitive marketplace.
With our strong network of technology partners, excellent domain expertise and differentiated value proposition, we are able to go above and beyond for our customers, far exceeding expectations.

Key Responsibilities

IT Documentation Management

  • Develop, maintain, and govern a centralized IT documentation repository covering infrastructure systems, network topology, server configurations, and asset inventories.
  • Create and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, technical guides, and architecture diagrams for all IT infrastructure components.
  • Establish and enforce documentation standards, templates, and version control practices across the IT team.
  • Conduct periodic reviews and audits of existing documentation to ensure accuracy, relevance, and compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage document lifecycle processes including creation, approval, revision, and archival.

Infrastructure Operations Support

  • Assist in the installation, configuration, and maintenance of servers, networking equipment, storage systems, and related infrastructure.
  • Document change management activities, including system upgrades, patching schedules, and infrastructure modifications.
  • Support incident management processes by maintaining accurate records of incidents, root cause analyses (RCA), and resolution steps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to capture and translate technical knowledge into clear, structured documentation.

Process & Compliance

  • Ensure IT documentation aligns with ITIL frameworks, ISO 27001, or other relevant standards adopted by the organization.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing and presenting accurate, up-to-date documentation packages.
  • Identify documentation gaps and proactively develop materials to address operational and compliance risks.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Liaise with system administrators, network engineers, security teams, and business units to gather technical information for documentation purposes.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT staff on documentation tools, standards, and best practices.
  • Prepare reports and dashboards on documentation coverage and status for IT management review.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent are advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum 1–3 years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience in producing technical documentation, SOPs, or knowledge base articles in a corporate IT environment.
  • Exposure to ITIL-based service management practices is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in English language, both written and spoken.
  • Proficiency with documentation and knowledge management tools
  • Solid understanding of IT infrastructure components including servers, networking, virtualization, storage, and cloud services.
  • Familiarity with diagramming tools such as Microsoft Visio, draw.io, or Lucidchart.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM processes including change management, incident management, and asset management.
  • Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) for automating documentation tasks is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible content.
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing and maintaining information.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

karriere tutor® steht für moderne, praxisnahe Weiterbildung und Umschulung – und für eine Lernkultur, die Menschen stark macht.
